requisito: Parses an array of CSV rows in the format "prodotto;categoria;quantita;prezzo" (optionally skipping the first header row, blank rows, and comments starting with '#'). Every data row must have 4 fields, non-empty text fields, and non-negative integer numbers, otherwise it throws FormatException. Computes valid row count, grand total, and category-filtered total (case-insensitive, or equal to grand total when filter is empty); if righe is null or empty returns "nessun dato".

difetti.indizio: Look at how format errors are handled while parsing a row.
difetti.spiegazione: The catch (Exception) block swallows any FormatException and silently skips malformed rows instead of letting parsing fail as specified.

difetti.indizio: Check the upper bound of the for loop iterating over the rows.
difetti.spiegazione: The condition i < righe.Length - 1 stops one element before the end, systematically dropping the last row in the array.

difetti.indizio: Look at what value is added to the filtered category accumulator.
difetti.spiegazione: totaleFiltro adds prezzo (unit price) instead of subtotale (quantity times price), undercounting every row whose quantity is not 1.

difetti.indizio: Check the types involved in computing each row's subtotal.
difetti.spiegazione: qta and prezzo are both int, so qta * prezzo silently overflows to negative when exceeding int.MaxValue before widening to long.

difetti.indizio: Look at how each row's category is compared against the requested filter.
difetti.spiegazione: StringComparison.Ordinal makes category matching case-sensitive, skipping valid rows that only differ in letter case.
